title: Whenever an API/Model error  is surfaced, return the control to the user
body:
### What happened? Whenever we are processing the stream and there is an error, if we continue the flow and let the nextSpeakerCheck run, there is a chance that it will choose the model to run again. When that happens, the client retries the existing history and duplicates the responses like the one that was interrupted. This can even enter into a loop. ### What did you expect to happen? Control should go back to the user. ### Client information
```console $ gemini /about # paste output here ```
### Login information _No response_ ### Anything else we need to know?

linked_prs.title: Do not call nextSpeakerCheck if there was an error processing the stream.
linked_prs.body:
## TLDR

Whenever we are processing the stream and there is an error, if we continue the flow and let the nextSpeakerCheck run, there is a chance that it will choose the model to run again. 

However, this may be a confusing behavior as discussed in the issue #7008 , with the client retrying again and showing the same partial results. 

Here, we are handling the control back to the user whenever there is an error processing the stream.
